rv.q: Hannah Price’s deftly acted production...Take away the scenes at the start and very end...and you have some unique and resonant drama that makes The Girl Who Fell something oddly memorable.'
It's totally unabashed, completely comfortable with its subject matter.

cn.t: Critics praise this oddly memorable production for its deft performances and unabashed, warming approach to unconventional subject matter, though some structural choices prove less effective.
